# ShopINVACARE

> > Official online store for Invacare medical equipment including wheelchairs, hospital-style homecare beds, patient lifts, and mobility aids for home healthcare.

ShopINVACARE offers a comprehensive range of Invacare-branded durable medical equipment designed for home care and patient mobility. The store features products that comply with FDA guidance and California Proposition 65 standards, including the popular 5410IVC homecare bed, RPL450-1 electric patient lift, and Tracer wheelchair series.

## Key Topics

- Invacare medical equipment
- Hospital-style homecare beds (5410IVC)
- Patient lifts (RPL450-1 Electric, hydraulic, sit-to-stand)
- Wheelchairs (Tracer SX3, EX1, SX5 series)
- Patient lift slings (Reliant, Standard)
- Bed rails and bed accessories
- Patient transfer and mobility aids
- FDA compliance and patient safety
- California Proposition 65
- Foldable wheelchairs with elevating legrests
- Overbed tables and trapeze bars
- Fluid-proof mattress covers
- Toileting and full-body slings
- Mobility equipment for home use
